templates.source: Bosch 'RTSP VIP Configuration Note' (doc 9007200806939915, www.boschsecurity.com / ipp.boschsecurity.com) — archived at usermanual.wiki/Bosch/RTSPVIPConfigurationNoteenUS9007200806939915.2663841228.pdf; and Bosch community post 'How to request a RTSP multicast stream from a BOSCH IP camera' (community.boschsecurity.com/t5/Security-Video/ta-p/16494). Document states: 'Stream 1 is the live video from the Dinion IP camera using encoding stream 1. Reception of stream 2 is accomplished by handing over the parameter inst to the RTSP server. The RTSP server does not need a web page addressed in the URL but needs the slash after the IP followed by ? as separator for the query string. Request: RTSP://160.10.0.1/?inst=2.'

Bosch 'RTSP VIP Configuration Note' (doc 9007200806939915, www.boschsecurity.com) — same document as main stream; inst=2 selects encoding stream 2 (sub). Example full URL with all parameters: RTSP://160.10.0.40/?h26x=4&line=3&inst=2&multicast=1&enableaudio=1&audio_line=1

https://download.catalogosicurezza.com/DOWNLOAD/Bosch/Documentazione/TVCC/Manuali/Prodotti_IP/rtsp%20.pdf — Bosch "RTSP usage with Bosch VIP Devices" (www.boschsecurity.com), section 3.2.8 Establish RTSP tunnel: parameter rtsp_tunnel, example RTSP://160.10.0.1/rtsp_tunnel (default RTSP port 554); note: rtsp_tunnel is a path, not part of the query string, and does not change the media transport mode — an alias of the default stream that also accepts the ?inst=<N> query (e.g. RTSP://160.10.1.100/rtsp_tunnel?tc=1...).

notes: Bosch VIP (Video IP) cameras use a query-string-only RTSP URL format with no fixed path beyond '/': rtsp://{user}:{pass}@{ip}:{port}/?inst=<N>. inst=1 = stream 1 (main/primary), inst=2 = stream 2 (sub/secondary). Additional documented parameters: line=<N> (selects camera/channel on multi-channel encoders), h26x=4 (selects H.264 encoding), multicast=1 (multicast transport), enableaudio=1&audio_line=<N> (audio). Port 554 is the standard RTSP port for direct streaming. /rtsp_tunnel is a documented alias path for the default stream on the standard RTSP port 554 (Bosch RTSP VIP note §3.2.8); it enables HTTP (port 80) tunneling when the client requests it and accepts the same ?inst=<N> query. Bosch is a proprietary OEM — these paths are not shared with Dahua/Hikvision/Axis. The 'RTSP VIP Configuration Note' is the authoritative source (doc 9007200806939915, originally at ipp.boschsecurity.com/en_US).
